ns2:section.sectionText: Note: This course is open to juniors and seniors in the News Editorial Journalism and Agricultural Communications majors only. Journalism graduate students are also eligible to register for this course. Please note the stated prerequisites. The registration system may temporarily allow you to select this course even if you do not meet the prerequisites, but it eventually will catch this problem and cancel your registration, by which time it may be difficult for you to find an alternative.
